description: This file defines a utility class 'SpeedCalculator' that provides static methods for calculating vehicle speed in miles per hour (mph), kilometers per hour (kph), and engine RPM based on input parameters such as RPM, vehicle speed, gear ratio, and units. It is part of the 'com.romraider.logger.car.util' package which is used in the RomRaider open-source car tuning project.

classes.name: SpeedCalculator
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to calculate vehicle speed in different units (mph, kph) and RPM based on sensor data and configuration constants.

methods.name: calculateMph
methods.description: Calculates vehicle speed in miles per hour from RPM and gear ratio.

methods.name: calculateKph
methods.description: Calculates vehicle speed in kilometers per hour from RPM and gear ratio.

methods.name: calculateRpm
methods.description: Calculates engine RPM based on vehicle speed, gear ratio, and units specification.
